content: Overall, the autocomplete system achieved high accuracy in reconstructing the keywords. Users marked the top suggestion from the autocomplete system to be semantically equivalent to the target $80.6$% of the time, and one of the top 3 was semantically equivalent $90.11$% of the time. The model also achieved a high exact match accuracy of 18.39%. Furthermore, the system was efficient, as users spent $3.86$ seconds typing keywords compared to $5.76$ seconds for full sentences on average. The variance of the typing time was $0.08$ second for keywords and $0.12$ second for full sentences, indicating that choosing and typing keywords for the system did not incur much overhead.
